name: Correlate alerts to incident / CI
intent: Bind an alert to the correct CI and open incident without creating duplicates.

ci.description: CI name to resolve via sn.cmdb.ci.find

procedure: If an open incident exists on that CI/service, attach / work-note rather than open a second incident.
Only open a new incident after confirm.
sideEffects: writes alert-incident correlation fields; optionally creates a new incident through the triage skill

prompts: Correlate alert ALRT0001234 to its incident.
Attach this alert to the existing incident.
Link alert ALRT0001234 to the CI db-prod-07.
